authority: exact current native input snapshot token, callback epoch, weak widget and original registered Slate user; no detached replay
cache: once per function per native callback; fresh callback is a new native query
analog: consumes native repeat state once; always handled after query including panic, unhandled reply or Destroy; failed reply commands discarded; no rollback of native navigation state
